channel.title: PAGASA NCRPRSD Advisories
channel.description: Aggregated rainfall, thunderstorm, and special forecasts from PAGASA NCRPRSD

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Watch #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 10:00 AM, 27 October 2026

Thunderstorm is MORE LIKELY to develop over Greater Metro Manila Area(Metro Manila, Bulacan, Rizal, Laguna and Cavite) within 12 hours.

All are advised to continue monitoring for updates.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 5 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 5-Final #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 12:17 AM, 27 October 2026(Tuesday)

All Thunderstorm Advisory over NCR-PRSD forecast area are now TERMINATED. However, all are still advised to continue monitoring for updates.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 7:00 PM, 26 October 2026(Monday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Quezon (San Narciso, Mulanay, San Francisco, San Andres, Catanauan, General Luna, and Buenavista) within the next 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
